# Instance producer varargs

This owned fixture preserves a public instance method whose invariant producer binds its own Object result, with a fixed String array passed to the original varargs declaration and a closed checked exception contract.

Four frozen caller routes compare 192 fresh cases twice, observing receiver reuse and overrides, array identity and partial writes, empty/null arrays, callback mutation, returned references, delayed casts and exact checked/runtime/error identity. Twenty independently wrong programs qualify those observations. Eight same-Code Signature controls retain original bytecode and reject unproved producer scopes and array bindings.

Both source and SDK declaration profiles compile every emitted unit and compare original class/method definitions, access roles, Signature and Exceptions. No private application names, inputs or output are included.
